data.name: Siru: a technology partnership around dynamic booking and commerce
data.body:
Approved description: a technology partnership around dynamic booking and commerce. Owner-confirmed work includes AI assistance, WhatsApp/Facebook/Instagram integration, English and Arabic, migration and staff training.

Siru is live and onboarding independent pharmacies across India. The founder reported 10,000+ sign-ups on 29 September 2026.

**Boundary:** keep the number as **10,000+ sign-ups** until the unit is confirmed. Do not call them active pharmacies, customers, users or completed onboardings. Do not claim Ryuk Labs owns Siru or that every demonstrated module is live for every business.

Links: https://siruapp.com/ · https://www.ryuklabs.io/stories/siru

Source: team outreach master context §5 (2026-10-01). Approved as a named claim by the owner (MCQ 2026-10-02, Q-ryuklabs-named-stories).

data.name: Redacted / TOKEN2049: the Dubai–Singapore flight experience
data.body:
